3: interface Product { sku: string; price: number; quantity: number }
4: 
5: export class Cart {
6:   private products = new Map<string, Product>();
7:   private coupons: number[] = [];
8: 
9:   add(sku: string, price: number, quantity = 1) {
10:     const key = pricing.normalizeSku(sku);
11:     if (price < 0 || quantity < 1 || !Number.isInteger(quantity)) throw new RangeError("product");
12:     const existing = this.products.get(key);
13:     this.products.set(key, { sku: key, price, quantity: quantity + (existing?.quantity ?? 0) });
14:   }
15: 
16:   remove(sku: string, quantity = Infinity) {
17:     const key = pricing.normalizeSku(sku);
18:     const product = this.products.get(key);
19:     if (!product) return false;
20:     if (quantity >= product.quantity) this.products.delete(key);
21:     else this.products.set(key, { ...product, quantity: product.quantity - quantity });
22:     return true;
23:   }
24: 
25:   applyCoupon(rate: number) {
26:     if (rate <= 0 || rate > 0.5) throw new RangeError("coupon");
27:     this.coupons.push(rate);
28:   }
29: 
30:   subtotal() {
31:     let amount = 0;
32:     for (const item of this.products.values()) amount += item.price * item.quantity;
33:     return pricing.roundMoney(amount);
34:   }
35: 
36:   total() {
37:     let amount = this.subtotal();
38:     for (const rate of this.coupons) amount = pricing.discountedPrice(amount, rate, "CNY");
39:     return pricing.roundMoney(amount / pricing.minorUnit);
40:   }
41: 
42:   items() {
43:     return [...this.products.values()].map((item) => ({ ...item }));
44:   }
45: 
46:   clear() {
47:     this.products.clear();
48:     this.coupons.length = 0;
49:   }
50: 
51:   get itemCount() {
52:     return this.items().reduce((total, item) => total + item.quantity, 0);
53:   }
54: }
55: 
56: export function checkoutEstimate(price: number): number {
57:   const discount = pricing.discountedPrice(price, 0.1, "CNY");
58:   return discount / pricing.minorUnit + pricing.serviceFee(price, 0.025, "CN") / pricing.minorUnit;

6: export function applyDiscount(price: number, rate: number = 0.1, currency?: string): number {
